doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Continuation of the Programme for provision of relief to people affected by the war situation in the Middle East
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-09-28 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - Action was previously taken to provide a fuel subsidy to consumers during the months of April, May, and June in the year 2026, with a view to mitigating the impact caused to the day-to-day lives of the general public and the overall economy due to the increase in global petroleum prices resulting from the conflict situation prevailing in the Middle East region. As the conflict persists, Government intervention has become essential to further alleviate the impact on the lives of the people. Accordingly, the Government has planned to provide a subsidy on the selling price of Auto Diesel and Industrial Diesel for a period of next 03 months enabling to maintain fuel prices at an affordable level for consumers without increasing fuel prices in the country in line with the increase in the global market thereby offering relief to the general public. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to allocate funds for providing this relief, subject to monthly limits of Rs.15 billion for October, Rs.13.5 billion for November, and Rs.12.15 billion for December, was approved by the Cabinet.
